entry.name: Fixed Viewpoint Tactile Dataset
entry.title: Fixed Viewpoint Tactile Dataset
entry.summary: One Tachin tactile glove (20 pads, 932 taxels) on a human hand, recorded by a static RGB-D camera and a fixed motion-capture setup tracking 20 hand points, over 160 episodes of 4 tabletop tasks (whiteboard wiping, peg-in-hole, pliers, cylinder lift).

sensor.note: 20 pads (tactile_0 to tactile_19, flattened per pad; 2-D shapes in meta/info.json tactile_2d_shapes): thumb tip 16x10, mid 4x8, base 6x15; index, middle and ring tip 9x8, mid 3x8, base 4x8, palm-side joint 3x4; pinky tip 9x8, mid 3x8, base 4x8, palm-side joint 3x4; palm 15x6. Pad roles from the publisher's visualize_dataset.py labels. Units not stated; values 0 to 2.6 in data file 0 with small per-episode offsets (the publisher's viewer subtracts the mean of the first 10 frames).

scale.text: 160 episodes, 59,158 frames at 20 fps (49 min), 4 tasks: peg-in-hole 82, whiteboard wiping 62, pliers 10, cylinder lift 6

entry.access: Hugging Face Tachintech/Fixed_Viewpoint_Tactile_Dataset, ungated, 3.8 GB LeRobot v3.0 (50 data parquet files, 50 RGB and 50 depth mp4 files).
caveats: One hand only; the card does not say which, and the checked video shows a single gloved hand.

Hand tracking is 20 points with a position and a quaternion each from a 'fixed-position motion-capture device' (固定机位动捕设备); the system, marker set and units are not named. Missing samples are stored as all-zero frames (0-1.2% of frames per checked episode).
Depth video is stored as 3-channel MPEG-4 Part 2 (lossy) with banding in the decoded frame; the depth encoding and units are not documented. RGB video is also MPEG-4 Part 2, not H.264.
Tactile units are not stated; meta/info.json declares float32 but the parquet stores float64.
Card text is in Chinese; the title, task strings and field names are English.
Task balance is uneven: the cylinder-lift episodes (6) show little touch (4 of 6 checked peak below 2 summed units above baseline).

tracking.note: observation_motion_positions (20 x 3) and observation_motion_quaternions (20 x 4, w-first in the publisher's viewer) per frame; the viewer labels them '20 markers, 5 fingers'

other: publisher web viewer (visualize_dataset.py) with pad layout and skeleton

sources: data/chunk-000/file-0000, 0022, 0023, 0024, 0025, 0030.parquet (whole files); videos/observation.images.color/chunk-000/file-0000.mp4 (whole); videos/observation.images.depth/chunk-000/file-0000.mp4 (one frame via ffmpeg range reads)
unconfirmed: taxels_per_hand=932 summed from meta/info.json tactile_2d_shapes (20 pads). The Demo01 release of the same maker has 880 values in 15 pads; this glove adds four 3x4 palm-side pads, a third pinky pad, and uses 6x15 / 15x6 shapes for thumb base and palm.
Glove on a human hand confirmed from RGB frames of episode 1 (gloved hand with a mount on the back, sweater sleeve). Which hand is not stated.

Motion-capture units not stated: within one frame the 20 points span up to about 1.66 units, which fits a hand only if the unit is decimetres; tracking method is classed 'other' because the system is not named.
scene_types 'lab' and scenes=1 from video frames (one white table with aluminium-profile rigs behind it).
Robot type field reads 'tactile_hand_motion_321_340'; its meaning is not documented.
Camera model not stated; 848x480 at 20 fps is the stored video size.

download.format: LeRobot v3.0: data/chunk-000/file-00NN.parquet (3-4 episodes each), videos/observation.images.color and .depth/chunk-000/file-00NN.mp4 (MPEG-4 Part 2, 848x480, 20 fps), meta/info.json, stats.json, tasks.parquet, episodes parquet
download.total_size: 3.8 GB (158 MB parquet, 388 MB RGB video, 3.27 GB depth video)
download.per_episode: one data file 1.3-4.4 MB + RGB 3-10 MB + depth 25-90 MB (each file holds 3-4 episodes)
download.partial_fetch: single files via resolve URLs; the episodes parquet maps each episode to its data/video file and time range

tasks: peg_in_hole: Pick up the cuboid block, adjust its posture and insert it into the hole (82)
blackboard_wiping: Pick up the yellow whiteboard eraser, move it to the whiteboard and wipe off the handwriting (62)
catch_pliers: Grasp the handle of the pliers, pick up the pliers and squeeze them a few times (10)
lift_cylinder: Grasp one side of the cylinder and lift the cylinder up (6)

sample.reason: Apache-2.0 (card YAML 'license: apache-2.0') allows redistribution; the repo is public and ungated. Label the collection 'Apache-2.0'.

sample.fetch_estimate: ~47 MB without depth (4 data files + 4 RGB videos); ~336 MB with the 4 depth videos
sample.rules_applied: 4 tasks (6 or fewer), so all are taken; more than 3 tasks, so one episode per task (4 in total, at least 3). All four are 11.9-26.9 s, so no window is cut. Contact was checked on the parquet files: per pad, the sum of values above the mean of the episode's first 10 frames, contact = sum above 1 for at least 20 frames (1 s).
deviations: Depth video uses an undocumented 3-channel lossy encoding; decide in step 3 whether to show it or only the RGB view.
